methodology: Equal weight for 11 work packages A0–A10; each completion percentage is an engineering-planning estimate rather than verified end-to-end throughput. Public YouTube channel creation and branding are included in A0.

milestones.evidence: Merged architecture, live Clivox branding and channel record

milestones.evidence: Code and CI working; live metadata API key not verified

milestones.evidence: Source-free editorial validator/fixtures/tests; licensed source context and human editorial review pending

milestones.name: Video renderer and AV quality assurance
milestones.evidence: Original-only FFmpeg/Pillow vertical synthetic renderer, SRT plan and ffprobe tests under CI; actual licensed media and recorded narration unresolved

milestones.name: Signed exact-video release
milestones.evidence: Ed25519 canonical release verification + unsigned quarantine fixture and adversarial CI; production key enrollment, real owner rights and final signed clip pending

milestones.name: Distinct Clivox YouTube OAuth
milestones.evidence: Strict Clivox-only read-only OAuth client and mocked validation; manual-only main workflow and live GitHub clivox-readonly environment independently verified with required reviewer, admin bypass disabled and main-only branch restriction; Google OAuth client/owner consent/refresh token absent, no live YouTube readback.

milestones.name: Protected private-first upload/scheduling
milestones.evidence: Private-first UTC schedule preflight, exact digest attempt-key, ambiguous/duplicate attempt dry-run and adversarial GitHub tests; no durable atomic ledger, write OAuth, real upload or schedule readback.

milestones.name: First licensed production pilot
milestones.evidence: Creator licensing and approved final render pending

milestones.name: Analytics and optimization
milestones.evidence: Synthetic-only Analytics API table parser, metric validation, null-aware Shorts Studio separation, within-category A/B comparison and adversarial GitHub CI; Clivox Analytics OAuth, published videos and genuine experiments still absent

most_important_blockers: Human-verifiable creator-issued commercial YouTube clipping permission
Exact source review and genuinely original clip edit
Distinct Clivox API OAuth and protected release environment
Actual QA-approved, signed and inventoried first pilot
Real licensed source edit + human narration and final audiovisual QA remain pending despite original-only A5 demo
A6 only verifies mathematical signatures in synthetic offline tests: no enrolled owner signing identity or approved final clip
A7 Clivox protected GitHub environment now exists, but Google owner OAuth consent, dedicated Clivox client/refresh credentials and live channel ID readback remain pending
A8 remains dry-run only: protected uploader credentials, atomic durable ledger and remote YouTube inventory reconciliation not configured
A10 uses invented future-dated synthetic fixtures; real authenticated Clivox analytics, validated Studio exports and eligible published samples do not exist
disclaimer: Progress estimates reflect partial engineering components, not a claim that third-party clips are licensed or an end-to-end publishing service exists.
